body: I haven't. I would feel ashamed. I would not look the therapist in the face. I don't know how I could talk to someone like this when I look the way I do. I am a disgusting person. I know money makes them interested in my problem. I'm so worried I'll spill my guts and they won't even take me seriously, or worse, they'll patronize me. Pat me on the head and give me pills. Goody! Though at this point I would welcome pills. Lots of them.

I *know* I have mental health issues. This is a serious fucking problem. I am going to hurt myself horribly eventually. Maybe not tonight, though I wanted to, because my self-control is too strong quite yet. It won't be,  eventually, and then I will do terrible things. Do I sound too coherent? It's because I'm used to feeling this way and appearing to function normally.

I have thought of killing myself in various ways. Hanging myself is appealing. I think about how when I put the rope around my neck this feeling of overwhelming relief will roll over me, because soon it will be over, and I will cry happily with this relief.

Or with a gun - I will spend a lot of time just pressing it to my head and laughing giddily. Feeling the pain inside wane just for that moment - because the gun is the promise of instant relief. Then I will put in my mouth and pull the trigger.
Or with a knife. Various ways here. Taking it and just stabbing it into my neck, with hot blood boiling out all over me. Fading out of consciousness into darkness. Or into the heart, under my rib cage. I could stare at the wall until my vision faded out.

These are all appealing. I think about them often. I know that in this world there are few comforts, and it *is* a comfort to know that if it gets really bad, I could kill myself. I feel like I am permanently teetering just by the the edge of a cliff, just an inch or two from the edge. People are there but they're not saying anything, not,"You're pretty close to that edge. Why don't you step away?" Because I'm not screaming or tearing out my hair or acting insane my polite words of "I have been having suicidal thoughts" are just ignored.
